newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith up as report highlights bid hopes.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith up as report highlights bid hopes.

text.p: Shares in WH Smith were indicated higher in pre-market trading on Monday after a weekend press report said the UK retailer was thought to be the target of a bid, dealers said.
The shares, down some 30 percent during the past two months, climbed 11p to 352-1/2 at 0714 GMT.
The Sunday Times said the group was on bid alert following rumours that a rival bidder was lining up financing to takeover WH Smith.

"The rumours have been around, but I don't know how credible they were," said one market maker, pointing to the sharp decline in the shares recently. "I think we'll see a few buyers just because it was in the paper."
That the company's value has fallen to 961 million stg, down from 1.5 billion last August, the newspaper said, adding that "The group is more vulnerable than ever in its 200-year history."
The list of potential bidders includes Boots Co Plc, ASDA Group Plc, Dixons Group Plc and Kingfisher Plc, the Sunday Times said.
